## Overview

EuroSAT is a benchmark dataset of 27,000 labeled Sentinel-2 satellite image patches covering 10 land-use/land-cover classes across Europe. This project applies both classical machine learning and deep convolutional neural networks to classify land cover from multispectral imagery.

**Classes:** Annual Crop · Forest · Herbaceous Vegetation · Highway · Industrial · Pasture · Permanent Crop · Residential · River · Sea/Lake

**Data source:** [EuroSAT dataset](https://github.com/phelber/EuroSAT) — Sentinel-2 multispectral (13 bands, 64×64 px patches)
